sql: WITH t AS (SELECT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) AS series, split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) AS dt, split_part(market_ticker,'-',3) AS word, market_ticker, pnl, quantity FROM paper_trades WHERE status = ANY(ARRAY['settled','closed_sl']) AND NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity>0 AND strategy LIKE '%mmsell%' AND strategy NOT IN (SELECT twin_tag FROM live_paper_twins) AND market_ticker LIKE 'KXTRUMPSAY%') SELECT word, count(*) FILTER (WHERE series='KXTRUMPSAY') AS wk, count(*) FILTER (WHERE series='KXTRUMPSAYMONTH') AS mo, count(*) FILTER (WHERE series='KXTRUMPSAYCOMPANY') AS co, count(DISTINCT series) AS n_series, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2) AS pnl FROM t GROUP BY word HAVING count(DISTINCT series) > 1 ORDER BY n_series DESC, word
